reviews.text_en: It wasn't really my best experience in a coffee shop; although the location is nice, the products are extremely expensive and not always of great quality.

reviews.text:
We had such a great experience at Dr. Weed Pong Phuket. It’s an incredibly professional and well-run establishment, with a really welcoming atmosphere from the moment you walk in.
The space is set up perfectly to relax, chill out, and just enjoy being part of the vibe. The staff are friendly, knowledgeable, and make you feel completely comfortable whether you’re new or experienced.
It’s not just a place to visit — it’s somewhere you can genuinely unwind and be part of the whole experience. Highly recommend if you’re in Phuket!
Nyi the best one
Cannabis felt expensive but all the store employees are really helpful and I tried everything they recommended.

Scammers & very rude staff. Do not go here, worst shop in patong. Expensive weed prices. Was sold a vape for £35 (I hadn’t figured the currency properly so thought it was a normal price) ONLY to leave the shop and it die one hour later? The workers are very rude. Asked for a refund as I expected the vape to work for more than an hour and they ‘didn’t do refunds as I paid with card’ disgusting shop. Ruined my experience in patong and will never return. He also had the cheek to get angry and raise his voice at me and told me to ‘not come back ever again’ when I requested a NEW vape? One that actually won’t die.
That one died later aswell anyway. Expensive lesson. Do not go here!!!!

The staff were incredibly helpful and friendly, creating a really welcoming vibe. The cannabis selection is high-quality and enjoyable.
It’s not the cheapest option in Patong, but the lovely terrace and overall experience more than make up for it!
Staff is very welcoming. Place is a bit expensive (which is fine considering the location).

Staff is here very rude, once you step a foot they will spam you with menu and will try to sell you everything they have.
I tried to play the dropped sticks game and won from the first try they started shouting and didn’t want to give me the prize after promising me a tshirt.
Be careful SCAMMERS!

The staff here are unbelievably rude and unprofessional. I visited last night to buy rolling papers and simply asked a normal question about how their price compares to 7/11. Instead of giving a basic answer, the employee started shouting in Thai and telling us to go somewhere else. It was completely unprovoked and ridiculous. I still paid, left a 10 baht tip out of courtesy, and walked out. After checking other reviews, it is obvious that this kind of rude and hostile behaviour is common at this shop and not a one time issue. Honestly, skip this place and go to any other weed store around the corner.
